Click any provider card — the panel on the right swaps to that provider's setup without moving.

Try Ollama (no key field), Custom endpoint (gains a base URL and headers), and Anthropic (explains why it isn't available yet).
The two tabs are gone. OpenAI-compatible vs Anthropic was the wire protocol — DevDeck's concern, not yours. It's now a line of small print under each provider's name.
